tasks.title: Establish Project Compliance Standards and Tooling
tasks.description: Define and document project standards based on README.md, and set up associated linting, formatting, and CI checks to ensure ongoing compliance.
tasks.details:
Thoroughly review `README.md` to extract all defined project standards (coding style, naming conventions, component patterns, directory structure, testing requirements, etc.). Configure ESLint with appropriate plugins (e.g., `eslint-plugin-react`, `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y`, `eslint-plugin-import`) and rules based on `README.md`. Configure Prettier for consistent code formatting. Configure Stylelint for CSS/SCSS linting if applicable. Set up Husky pre-commit hooks to run linters and formatters before commits.

`npx lint-staged`
`// lint-staged.config.js`
`module.exports = { "*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}": ["eslint --fix", "prettier --write"], "*.{css,scss}": ["stylelint --fix", "prettier --write"] }`
Document any ambiguities or missing standards and seek clarification.

tasks.title: Finalize Atom Refactoring
tasks.description: Complete the refactoring of all atoms in `src/atoms/` to ensure they adhere to the new pattern outlined in `README.md` and established in Task 1.
tasks.details:
The refactoring process for each atom in `src/atoms/` will involve the following steps:

1.  **Identify Atom:** Determine the specific atom(s) to refactor from the `src/atoms/` directory.
2.  **Read Files:** Review the atom's source file (`src/atoms/{atomName}.ts`), its corresponding test file (`src/atoms/{atomName}.test.ts` if it exists), and the main atom index file (`src/atoms/index.ts`) for any related type definitions or registrations.
3.  **Compare to Pattern:** Cross-reference the atom's current structure with the checklist provided in `README.md` under the section 'Things to check when refactoring atoms to use the new pattern'. This checklist includes verifying:
    *   A single atom per file, with a default export for the atom instance.
    *   Core logic encapsulated in a named `{atomName}Fn` export.
    *   The `{atomName}Fn` is pure, testable, accepts essential parameters, and is correctly utilized by the default exported atom.
    *   The atom's value type is defined and exported from `src/atoms/index.ts` and correctly used within `{atomName}.ts`.
    *   Comprehensive unit tests for `{atomName}Fn` are present in `{atomName}.test.ts`.
    *   The atom is correctly registered in `src/atoms/index.ts` with its `name`, `description`, and the `atom` instance.
    *   Consolidation of separate state and mutation atoms into a single atom, if applicable.
    *   Correct import paths and dependency management.
    *   Adherence to established naming conventions.
4.  **Implement Changes:** Apply the necessary refactoring using tools like `replace_in_file` or `write_to_file` to modify the atom's source code and related files.
5.  **Test & Verify:** Create or update unit tests for the `{atomName}Fn` to ensure its correctness. Update `src/atoms/index.ts` with any changes to type definitions and ensure the atom's registration is accurate.
6.  **Lint & Build:** Execute the linting and build check scripts: `./check-lint-build-errors.sh src/atoms/{atomName}.ts` and `./check-lint-build-errors.sh src/atoms/index.ts` to ensure code quality and catch any build issues.

Special attention should be given to instances of `atomFamily`, as they may require specific adaptations to the standard refactoring pattern.

This task provides the general framework. It will be expanded into subtasks for each atom or group of related atoms.
tasks.testStrategy:
The refactoring of each atom will be tested as follows:
1.  **Unit Testing:** Create or update comprehensive unit tests for the core logic function (`{atomName}Fn`) in its respective `{atomName}.test.ts` file.
2.  **Linting and Building:** Run `./check-lint-build-errors.sh src/atoms/{atomName}.ts` and `./check-lint-build-errors.sh src/atoms/index.ts` to ensure code quality, style compliance, and successful build.
3.  **Code Review:** A thorough code review by another developer against the standards outlined in `README.md`, particularly the 'Things to check when refactoring atoms to use the new pattern' checklist.
4.  **Integration Check:** Verify that the atom is correctly registered in `src/atoms/index.ts` and that its type definitions are accurate and exported.
5.  **Visual/Functional Check (if applicable):** For atoms with UI implications or complex interactions, a manual visual check or basic rendering test in a test environment or Storybook (if Storybook is in use and updated for the atom) should be performed.

tasks.title: Implement Unit Tests for Atoms
tasks.description: Develop and implement comprehensive unit tests for all atom components, ensuring they meet quality and coverage standards.
tasks.details:
Set up the testing environment using Jest and React Testing Library (or project-specified tools). For each atom refactored in Task 2: Create a `MyAtom.test.js` (or `.tsx`) file. Write tests to cover: Basic rendering, rendering with different props, event handling, and accessibility. 
`// pseudo-code for an atom test (e.g., Button.test.js)`
`import { render, screen, fireEvent } from '@testing-library/react';`
`import Button from './Button';`
`test('renders button with text', () => { render(<Button>Click Me</Button>); expect(screen.getByText('Click Me')).toBeInTheDocument(); });`
`test('calls onClick prop when clicked', () => { const handleClick = jest.fn(); render(<Button onClick={handleClick}>Click</Button>); fireEvent.click(screen.getByText('Click')); expect(handleClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1); });`
Aim for >80% statement coverage for each atom.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `npm test` or `yarn test` and ensure all atom tests pass. Check test coverage reports. Review test cases for completeness and correctness (e.g., testing edge cases, all prop variations).

tasks.title: Investigate and Report: Component Compliance
tasks.description: Analyze all existing components (excluding atoms) to identify deviations from the new project standards and document required changes in a detailed report.
tasks.details:
Identify all "component" level modules. For each component, compare its current implementation against standards in `README.md` (Task 1). Document findings in a structured format: Component Name, File Path, Compliance Issues, Suggested Refactoring Steps, Estimated Effort. 
`// Example report entry:`
`// Component: UserProfileCard`
`// Path: src/components/UserProfileCard.jsx`
`// Issues: Uses outdated styling method, props not typed.`
`// Suggested: Convert to CSS Modules, add PropTypes/TypeScript.`
`// Effort: M`
tasks.testStrategy: Peer review of the generated report for accuracy, thoroughness, and clarity. Ensure all components (excluding atoms and pages) are covered. Verify that "compliance issues" directly map to standards in `README.md`.

tasks.description: Analyze all existing pages to identify deviations from the new project standards and document required changes in a detailed report.
tasks.details:

tasks.testStrategy: Peer review of the report. Ensure all application pages/routes are covered. Verify that findings are actionable and clearly linked to project standards.

tasks.details:
